title: Cash drawer & close
openingHint: Count the cash you are starting with. Suggested = last closing balance.
countTitle: Count what is in the drawer
countHint: Enter the actual amount for each method. The expected totals are revealed after you review.
closedHint: The closing cash carries over as tomorrow's opening float.
drawerFail: Could not open drawer (check printer mode)
cashDrawerSubtitle: Manage the cash drawer: opening float, cash in/out, and cash on hand. Final settlement (all payment methods) is done in Daily Settlement.
settleInDailyHint: To close the shift, run Final Settlement in Daily Settlement (Floor Plan / Live Orders) — count every payment method (cash, card by type, e-wallet) against expected.
finalSettlementHint: Check the card terminal batch, cash drawer and e-wallet apps, then enter the ACTUAL amount for each method. The system compares against expected and flags differences.
noOpenShift: No open shift to settle. Start a shift in Cash Drawer first.
